_about: How senders are handled (core/senders.py). A sender at one of internal_domains (or a subdomain) is 'internal': its email gets internal_category by its address, without any model call, and is handled automatically. The addresses in retail_support_emails.txt are the exception: their emails are classified as usual and flagged 'forwarded by retail support'. Changes apply the next time an email is classified or shown.
